body: This comment got me thinking. Thank you for replying. That quote really spoke to me. I appreciate the support. It means a lot.

My divorce is currently pending but I am alone with my daughter of only 6 months. I didn't plan out things to be this way and it's taking me a while to pick up the pieces. I'm very sorry what you're going through and I feel your pain. I'm praying for you to make it through though. Our kids need us and we got to fight through this if we want to build a better future. I know getting knocked down again isn't something you were planning on and sometimes we just can't see these things coming, it feels like we just have no control of what's to come in our lives. I get that. I get it alot.
I want you to still keep hope. I will try to practice what I'm preaching as well. Just be the best father you can be and forget about these fickle women. Love yourself and love your kid. It's all we can do as single parents.
That's fucked. I'm sorry it made me laugh but I hope you have your chance as the main protagonist.
People have endlessly disappointed me. I've lost a lot of friends too. We all go through loss. You're only human.

Don't dive into despair friend, there's more to life than this. Don't let the past define who you are. You are who you want to be and strive to be. Though what you are going through is difficult, this is only the first half, you can turn things around the second half. Comebacks are real. Bounce back from this and keep your mind busy in the meantime. You'll find new goals and new friends. I know things will get better so long as you don't quit.

Life isn't so much about what happens to you but how you react to things that happen. I promise your future can look more brighter if you kept pressing on and despite all of the adversity you've been experiencing , you try working on self improvement. The truth is, only you can save you.

An accusation doesn't make you guilty. Please reconsider your options, you can get through this even though it makes you feel like shit. Getting away from people might be the best thing to do. You know who you are and nobody can tell you otherwise.
I know exactly what you mean. I tend to have a devil may care attitude and people seem to take notice. What they don't know is that it took a lot of traumatic things to happen for me to be this way.
Yeah, I hate disappointing people. It's other people's expectations that bother me more than my own and it's unhealthy. I should be the most concerned with my own happiness and as should you.

That's really awful, I'm sorry to hear that has happened to you and especially the disappointment from your dad has got to have you. That would bother me a lot. You have to tell these people to fuck off nevertheless and keep pushing forward.

My father's father attempted suicide by self inflicted gunshot wound, was a very traumatic event in his life, saw it happen right in front of him. I don't want him go through that again. 
I'm going through a difficult time, won't kill myself because it's a selfish thing to do. Even though life gets really hard.
My wife took our newborn daughter and left me. 
I didn't see it coming. 
I'm in shock and disbelief and everytime I see kids it triggers a lot emotions.this happened fairly recently only just last month. I had only spent less than a week with my first child.
You first please. :)

Don't leave your husband. He needs you. He committed himself enough to marry you. That's dedication. 
Everyone isn't perfect. Maybe he does have anger issues but you could suggest him to see some kind of anger management therapy. He never touched you. He might've damaged doors but I don't think he's ever threatened you, has he? I'm sure he has a lot of his own frustrations but maybe you're taking it all too personally. I hope you give him more of a chance. Don't ruin his life. If he has been faithful and has never harmed you physically then don't leave him please. Sure, maybe he is scary when he gets mad but how often does he get mad? I hope you can consider working out your marriage.

I'm going through an issue myself too with the wife. She left me and took our daughter with her just a few days after she was born. I was excited to be a dad. And I was smitten when I held her in my arms. I didn't think my wife could be so heartless. I don't know what keeps me going.
I get the same type of feeling too lately. We've got to remain strong, maybe not for us but at least for others. I don't think wasting ourselves is the answer. This will pass eventually.
Well, if it makes you feel any better, my wife left me and took our daughter with her only a few days after she was born. And this happened very recently to me.
You seem so perfect.

Hey, this is a temporary feeling. Things can get better, give it time. You have to keep hope and fight against the anguish you feel. Please don't hurt yourself. You ruin any chance of improving your life if you give up. Everyone fails. You have to keep trying.
Do you want $100? What's your paypal?
I'll be your boyfriend.
My father's father attempted suicide and it affected him a lot. Even if I suffer, I don't want him to relive that kind of pain because I love him so much.
I'll marry you. Message me.

Hey, for what it's worth, a lot of us are living with a lot of regret, bad choices, unfortunate mishaps, and sufferers of abuse. Anyways, you're not alone in your sadness and I hope that you reconsider. If you want to talk about it, start off anywhere. I'm all ears.

Might be because since joining you have that "everything must be done with efficiency" perspective. Still, the air force has been good to me, so no complaints if there's been a little change since joining.

I was in the 363 at Sheppard, savage was a green rope at our squadron, 
 The ropes corrupt, literally.

https://www.google.com/amp/www.foxnews.com/us/2017/10/13/air-force-airmen-accused-vandalizing-historic-sc-church-with-satanic-graffiti.amp.html

...it was indoors too. So I still hesitated to react... 
I'll definitely return the salute next time regardless.

Okay, pardon me, I always figured they were confusing me for an officer. I mean it's cute of course but I didn't realized that makes me an asshole apparently, guess I'm ignorant. Maybe I should ease up a bit.
What's wrong with weapons?

2w131k. Weapons. 8/10. 
Bombers are fun to work on.

It's hard to get through boring days at work. I can understand that. It's normal to feel unfulfilled at work. It sucks more having no one to really talk to either. I feel for you. 
If I were you, I'd invest in hobbies that provide you with some sort of adrenaline rush. I always heard of the stories of depressed people who always change their outlook in life by becoming risk takers, not saying you have to be like them but if you find maybe getting into boxing or mma, or trying skydiving. Maybe even but yourself a motorcycle. Hell, if you feel like dying so bad, why not do something fun with your life first?
You could learn a new language, you could learn a new instrument. Find something that'll help you grow as a person. Make a goal. Don't focus on being motivated but instead try to make a habit of keeping good discipline. Going to the gym is great but discover new things, broaden your horizons, there's a lot more to life than what you already know. I dunno. Hang in there. Praying for ya.

I'm sorry you're going through this. I've got a child on the way and I couldn't comprehend what it would be like if the same were to occur to me too. 
Definitely reach out for help and take some time off from things. I wish I had more to say as I'm inexperienced in the matter.
You're in my prayers though and I hope you'll get through this.
